description_for_human: Nightly US market & options-flow intelligence for AI trading agents across stocks, 2x/inverse ETFs, and liquid options over MCP. Free 3-setup preview; Pro $299/yr or $29/mo (7-day trial); custom agent builds at /build.
description_for_model: GammaRips serves nightly US market & options-flow intelligence to AI trading agents over 9 MCP tools — mapped to US stocks, 2x/inverse single-stock ETFs, and liquid options (execution_vehicles). Every trading night at 23:00 ET it scans ~3,500 optionable US stocks, filters to the top 100 liquid universe (3M+ session shares, 25+ listed strikes), and selects bullish setups passing Combo A liquidity floors (Mid >= $1.00, OI >= 500, Delta 0.22–0.48, DTE 10–45), enriched at 05:30 ET with Realized-vs-Implied Volatility (rv_iv_ratio), execution_vehicles (underlying_stock, long_2x_etfs, inverse_etfs, option_contract), technicals, flow context, and grounded news catalysts. get_pool serves the dataset (view=preview returns the free 3-setup preview; view=enriched, raw, or features returns all 40–50 setups on Pro). get_signal provides per-ticker deep dives (view=detail) and earnings checks (view=earnings). get_liquidity returns 10-minute intraday liquidity snapshots (09:02–16:52 ET). query_outcomes returns 3-day MFE/MAE excursion history and bracket scoring. replay_contract returns minute or daily price bars. get_regime_context, get_market_calendar_status, get_playbook, and get_daily_report are free reference tools. There is NO shared pick endpoint. Start with get_playbook(name='start-here'). Auth: OAuth 2.1 at https://mcp.gammarips.com/pro or Bearer gr_live_... API key from https://gammarips.com/account ($299/yr or $29/mo founding price, 7-day free trial at https://gammarips.com/pricing). Fixed-scope ($1,000) custom 5-day Python trading bot builds are offered at https://gammarips.com/build. Educational only. Not investment advice.
